name: Infortrend Technology, Inc.
summary: Infortrend Technology, Inc. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of disk array storage systems in Europe, Taiwan, China, Japan, the United States, and internationally. The company offers EonStor CS, a scale-out NAS storage system for use in a range of data-intensive applications and industries, such as media and entertainment, high performance computing, video surveillance archiving, file sharing, and data backup. It provides EonStor GS, an enterprise unified storage solution; EonStor GSe, a storage system for common SMB-level applications, such as media editing and office file sharing; and EonStor GSe Pro, a single controller solution for SMBs.
